    // True when the weights sum to one within tolerance (a valid affine
    // combination identifying a point on the triangle's support plane). Does not
    // test the convexity condition U, V, W >= 0 (see the type doc comment).
    IsNormalized(self: BarycentricCoordinate, tolerance: Number): Boolean
        => (self.U + self.V + self.W).AlmostEqual(1.0, tolerance);
